notes.title: 🌾 The Farm & Store Simulator Demo Is Available Now - Play Free Today!
notes.notes:
Hey farmers!

The wait is over - grab your boots and step into the countryside, because the FREE Demo for Farm & Store Simulator is available now on Steam!

Whether you're a longtime fan of cozy farming games or just starting your agricultural journey, this is your chance to experience the perfect blend of relaxing gameplay and satisfying strategy.

In the DEMO, you’ll:

🌱 Plant and harvest a variety of crops

🐄 Raise animals and take care of your growing farm

🧺 Stock your store with homegrown goods

💰 Set prices, manage your shop, and attract happy customers

🧱 Lay the foundation for a thriving farm-to-market business

Build, grow, and optimize your little piece of paradise - all at your own pace. Whether you’re here for the chill vibes or the clever management mechanics, there's something for everyone.

And yes, it’s completely free to play - no pressure, just progress.

So don’t wait - fire up Steam, hit that Download Demo button, and get your hands dirty (in a good way)!

👉 Play the Free Demo on Steam Now

The soil’s ready. The store is yours.
Let’s grow something amazing. 🌻
